subject: Double charged on monthly subscription invoice #INV-88912
body: Hello, our finance department noticed we were billed twice for the enterprise tier on March 1st ($4,500 x 2). Can you please reverse the second charge immediately and provide an updated receipt?

subject: CRITICAL: Database connection pool exhausted causing HTTP 500 errors on API
body: Our production cluster in us-east-1 is throwing connection timeouts on the primary PostgreSQL database. Over 30% of user requests are failing right now. Urgent assistance required!

subject: ¿Cómo puedo exportar mis datos de usuario en formato CSV?
body: Hola, estoy revisando la nueva interfaz y no encuentro la opción de descargar el reporte de clientes en formato CSV. ¿Me podrían indicar los pasos para generarlo?

subject: Security notification: Unrecognized login attempt from unknown IP
body: I received an alert that my account was accessed from an IP located in another country at 3 AM. I did not initiate this login. Please lock sessions and verify my 2FA status.

subject: Запрос на изменение платежных реквизитов компании
body: Добрый день. Нам необходимо обновить банковские реквизиты нашей организации для выставления счетов за следующий квартал. Прикрепите, пожалуйста, форму запроса.

subject: Feature request: Dark mode support for desktop dashboard
body: Hey team, loving the platform so far! Just wondering if dark mode is on the product roadmap for Q3? Working late hours in bright white hurts the eyes a bit.

subject: Unacceptable service downtime - cancelling contract immediately if unresolved
body: This is the third time your service has dropped this week during peak trading hours. We are losing hundreds of dollars per hour. If your team doesn't resolve this permanently within 2 hours, we are pulling our enterprise agreement.

subject: パスワードリセットの確認メールが届きません
body: お世話になっております。ログインパスワードの再設定を行いましたが、30分経っても認証コードのメールが届きません。迷惑メールフォルダも確認済みです。

subject: Dúvida sobre limites do plano Pro
body: Olá! Gostaria de saber quantas chamadas de API por minuto estão incluídas no plano Pro anual antes que ocorra throttling.

subject: Suspicion de fuite de clé API dans un dépôt public
body: Bonjour, un de nos développeurs a accidentellement committé une clé d'API de production sur GitHub il y a 20 minutes. Nous l'avons révoquée, mais nous souhaitons auditer les logs d'accès récents.

subject: Missing refund confirmation for cancelled order #ORD-4410
body: Hi there, your representative told me last Thursday that my refund would process within 48 business hours, but my bank statement still shows nothing. Can you check the transaction status?

subject: Webhook payload structure documentation question
body: Hello, I am integrating your webhooks into our Zapier workflow. Does the 'payment_succeeded' event payload contain the customer's tax VAT number or only the subtotal?
